title: Grateful Dead Live at William And Mary Hall - College Of William And Mary on 1973-09-12
venue: William And Mary Hall - College Of William And Mary

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a low‑volume mix but clear sound, showcasing a solid set highlighted by Bird Song, Weather Report Suite and an energetic Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The board tape captures a pleasant, if modestly mastered, audio picture – occasional dropouts and a mislabeled track aside, it’s listenable. Musically the show is uneven: some fans call it pedestrian, yet others praise the soaring Bird Song, jazzy Weather Report Suite and a high‑energy Eyes of the World, plus strong moments on Let It Grow and Sing Your Blues Away.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers note decent performance with several standout songs, but recording issues (low volume, drop‑outs, labeling error) and divergent opinions keep the overall score in the upper‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low master volume gives a subdued feel; occasional audio glitches reported. One track mislabeled (Ramble On Rose vs Tennessee Jed) and an early‑set cut affecting Eyes of the World.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set maintains a soulful, steady groove; second set appears truncated and suffers from an early cut, but still contains high‑energy peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for crazed rhythm guitar with Bobby and for adding new slide phrases after Eyes of the World; overall strong playing noted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned sharing a wild, dual‑guitar attack on Let It Grow and possibly delivering the encore announcement.
